title: [Prime] 2x Continental Grand Prix 5000 700x28c Folding Tyres - $132.01 Delivered @ Amazon UK via AU
body:
Deal: [Prime] 2x Continental Grand Prix 5000 700x28c Folding Tyres - $132.01 Delivered @ Amazon UK via AU

[4foxache] Good deal only catch is looks like tan sidewalls not fully black
[daunce] Perfectly fine to complain about. I wouldn’t buy tan sidewalls.
[moph] Tan sidewalls look great on some bikes and not so great on others. It's quite common for people to have a preference
[qtr pounder] Ohhhh, folding bike tyres.
I was like wtf are 'folding tyres'.
[browser] They come folded, no difference once mounted. They use Kevlar instead of steel wire, hence lighter and more flexible than rigid tyres.
[hopper] I cycle daily but a noob regarding tires. I don't see any grip on these tires. It's that normal?
[moph] This is normal for road tyres. If you're commuting or training on roads or cycle paths, these tyres are amazing and you will enjoy the smooth ride.
[avtek] i agree with most of what you said - they are my favorite tyres - however if i were commuting on a daily basis on australian roads i would probably get the continental all seasons tyres - they wont ride as nice but have better wet weather grip and puncture resistance
[browser] Normal for road tyres, for reduced rolling resistance. But 32 width is better, in terms of comfort and rolls better, though many performance frames don't clear 32.
[browser] Yeah, that's my preference, used to run GP4000 and 4000S in 32.
[linkser] Yay, that is a very good price for the GP5000.
I prefer the tan wall version for my bike, not taking questions from all you tan wall haters.
